文献题目: Pd Ion-Exchange and Ammonia Etching of a Prussian Blue Analogue to Produce a High-Performance Water-Splitting Catalyst
1. 解决的问题: 该文针对高性能双功能析氢/析氧催化剂仍高度依赖贵金属、而现有非贵金属体系在酸碱两种环境下难以同时兼顾活性、结构可设计性和稳定性的问题，以 PBA 为可编辑前驱体构建 Pd 交换和氨刻蚀协同调控策略。作者目标是得到具有高比表面积、暴露活性位和优化吸附能的碳基纳米片催化剂，用于整体水分解。

2. 具体的合成步骤.描述性总结: 作者先通过共沉淀法制备 NiCo-PBA，再用浓氨水刻蚀生成 e-NiCo-PBA，或者同时引入 Pd(acac)2 进行离子交换和氨刻蚀得到 Pd-e-NiCo-PBA。最后将不同 PBA 前驱体在 Ar 气氛下低温煅烧，得到对应的碳复合催化剂，其中目标样品为 Pd-e-NiCo-PBA-C。

参数列表.试剂/对象: nickel nitrate + sodium citrate + potassium hexacyanocobaltate(III)
参数列表.参数: 0.6 mmol nickel nitrate + 0.9 mmol sodium citrate in 25 mL water; 0.4 mmol K3Co(CN)6 in 25 mL water; dropwise addition over 10 min; age 24 h; wash; vacuum dry at 60 C overnight
60 mg NiCo-PBA in 30 mL ethanol; add 30 mL water containing 7.5 mL concentrated ammonia (28%); stir 1 h at room temperature; wash and dry
60 mg NiCo-PBA in 30 mL 10 mM palladium acetylacetonate ethanol solution; add 30 mL water containing 7.5 mL concentrated ammonia (28%); stir 1 h at room temperature; wash and dry
heat to 350 C at 1 C min^-1 under Ar; keep 3 h; cool at 10 C min^-1

3. 性能.数值: 97.3% activity retained; negligible LSV shift after 5000 cycles
